svg.text: Polkit · attached to the requester (1:1 crop)

g.text: Meta+← on the focused window's left edge,
Meta+→ in the gap between columns, Meta+3 on
zone 3, Meta+F centred on the focused window.
Live mode: press it and watch
Pressing a chord performs it and pulses its label
blue. The sheet stays; the labels ride the rects.
20 px, radius 6, 1 px cyan edge, 12 px tabular.
Non-spatial chords go in the right-edge column.
The card hangs from the top edge of the window whose pid asked,
under a rose 2 px band that breathes (border-pulse). Rest dimmed 20%.
No centred dialog, no filled button
Field radius 6, card radius 10, password focus is white.
Cancel / Authenticate are text with a 2 px underline.
